ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope and impact of child care fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future scandal and other cases
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records research
questions: What is the total amount of fraud committed in Minnesota child care programs?
How many individuals and organizations are involved in these schemes?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose widespread corruption and abuse of taxpayer funds, and could lead to significant reforms in child care programs
